reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team, and the 23 May deadline is still unconfirmed.

I found nothing to back it up. There are no Thornbury Cloth Co. files in the share I can see, and nobody has mentioned Thornbury or an order form deadline in #central-team.

I also pointed out that 23 May has already passed (today is 14 Oct). So it could be an old deadline, next May's, or just misheard. I suggested she check with her Thornbury contact or the account owner before anyone plans around it, and told her I'm not treating it as a confirmed date.
